candidate_relations.reason: The biopsy in this case did show neutrophilic panniculitis, but BADAS is the overarching clinicopathologic diagnosis integrating the bowel disease (ulcerative colitis), hemorrhagic vesicular skin lesions, and arthritis (swollen right knee). Neutrophilic panniculitis is a histologic component/manifestation of BADAS rather than the final diagnostic entity requested.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Neutrophilic panniculitis describes the histopathologic finding seen on biopsy but does not capture the full clinical syndrome of bowel-associated dermatosis-arthritis syndrome (BADAS), which requires the composite of bowel disease, skin lesions, and arthritis

case_quality_flags: BADAS is a rare diagnosis in pediatric patients; the case provides strong composite clinical evidence (bowel disease, neutrophilic skin lesions, arthritis) supporting the reference diagnosis over the histologic descriptor alone.
